title: Anatomy of a Page
That <g>Books Calls</g>
subtitle: Four parts. Each one does a single job.

mock.headline:
Your week is lost in tabs.
Let's fix one workflow.
mock.sub: For small teams who tried AI and got stuck. One month, one workflow, running in your tools.
mock.note: No pitch. You tell me where you're stuck.

cards.title: Their words, not mine
cards.body: Name the problem the way the client says it. Their words beat consultant language.

cards.title: Who it's for
cards.body: One line that says who it helps and what changes for them.

cards.title: One clear ask
cards.body: One button, one next step. Lower the risk first.

cards.title: Show it working
cards.body: A real screen of the system running beats a promise.
